skill.summary: Execute code on Google Colab GPU runtimes (T4/L4/A100/H100) and manage persistent storage via Google Drive. Use when tasks need GPU compute (ML training, inf...

latestVersion.changelog: v1.3.0: Added 'resume' command to reconnect to kept-alive runtimes (skips VM assignment, reuses installed packages and /tmp files). 'stop' without args stops saved runtime. State saved to ~/.colab-runtime-state.json. Note: Python variable state does not persist across reconnections — use file checkpoints.
